metadata.description: Statistical observations supporting KSI review. Observations annotate behavioral signals (frequency, breadth, trend); they never change a KSI assertion.

observations.recommendation: Deactivate unused credentials; rotate aged keys. Unused active credentials are standing attack surface with no operational purpose.

observations.detail: KSI-PIY-GIV failed 10 times in the last 90 days — repeated remediation without a durable fix.
observations.recommendation: Review the remediation cluster for this KSI; a recurring failure usually means the fix addresses the symptom, not the configuration source (e.g. unmanaged drift).
